notices.title: SSC Board Exams Recounting/Reverification Notice
notices.content: Students wishing to apply for recounting or reverification of their Class 10 (SSC) board exam papers must submit applications to the office before 10th June 2026 along with the required challan.

notices.title: Summer Vacation Announcement
notices.content: Summer holidays will begin on 24th April 2026 and end on 11-06-2026. Home assignments have been distributed, and students are advised to revise lessons daily.

notices.title: SA-2 (Summative Assessment) Final Examination Timetable
notices.content: The final examinations for all classes will begin from 16th April 2026. The detailed subject-wise timetable is posted on the admin notice board and distributed in class groups.

notices.title: School Reopening for Academic Year 2026-2027
notices.content: All classes (6th to 10th) will resume from 12-06-2026. Parents are requested to ensure students attend in full uniform. Textbooks and JVK kits will be distributed on the reopening day.

proposals.title: Leveling & Fencing of Junior Kabaddi and Kho-Kho Sports Ground
proposals.description: Grading red soil, leveling ground surface, installing perimeter protective mesh wire fencing, and procuring new volleyball nets.

proposals.title: High-Speed BSNL Bharat Fiber & Smart IFP Annual Maintenance Setup
proposals.description: Deploy 200 Mbps dedicated fiber internet connection to all 5 smart classroom IFPs and provide annual hardware maintenance coverage.

proposals.title: Classroom Ergonomic Dual-Desk Bench Furniture Procurement (Classes 6-8)
proposals.description: Procurement of 40 heavy-duty wooden dual desks with bag hooks to replace aging benches and accommodate rising student enrollment.

proposals.title: Installation of Solar-Powered RO Safe Drinking Water Plant
proposals.description: Setup of 500 LPH RO water plant connected with school rooftop solar panel to ensure 100% pure fluoride-free drinking water for students and staff.

meetings.title: Mid-Term Review & Dual Desk Furniture Allocation
meetings.agenda:
1. Voting on Dual-Desk procurement
2. Fiber internet connectivity for smart IFP panels
3. Pre-Final exam preparation schedule for 10th class
4. Sports Day ground preparation
meetings.minutesSummary: Committee verified quotations from AP State Agro Industries and local carpenters for dual desks. Passed resolution to fast-track BSNL fiber connection for smart classrooms.

meetings.title: Quarterly School Development & Health Sanity Review
meetings.agenda:
1. Review of RO drinking water proposal
2. Mid-Day Meal rice stock inspection
3. SASA Clean Campus action schedule
4. Parent feedback on digital IFP teaching
meetings.minutesSummary: Unanimously approved Solar RO drinking water plant installation (Budget ₹1.2L). Headmaster briefed committee on JVK kit distribution 100% completion. Resolution passed to request Gram Panchayat for regular campus weed clearing.

actionItems.taskDescription: Organize parent-teacher conference for Class 10 board exam preparation strategy
actionItems.completionNotes: Circular prepared and parent schedule calendar uploaded.

actionItems.taskDescription: Coordinate with BSNL Venkatagiri office for optical fiber cable trenching to computer lab
actionItems.completionNotes: Line estimate approved; awaiting router dispatch.

actionItems.taskDescription: Inspect sample dual-bench desk build quality and finalize vendor purchase order
Obtain water testing feasibility report from RWS (Rural Water Supply) department for RO plant
actionItems.completionNotes: Water sample sent to district lab at Gudur. Results expected within 3 days.

sasaActivities.title: Haritha Haram - School Plantation
sasaActivities.description: Planted 50 native shade trees and ornamental plants along the school boundary walls. Sponsored by local Gram Panchayat.

sasaActivities.title: Cleanliness Drive - Playground
sasaActivities.description: Cleaned plastic waste, weeds, and wild grass from the main playground. Staff and senior students participated together.

facilityNotes.title: Mandal Kabaddi Tournament Selection Trials
facilityNotes.content: Daily morning fitness and practice drills from 7:45 AM to 8:30 AM under physical education teacher guidance. Good response from 8th and 9th boys and girls.

facilityNotes.title: Science Practical Chemical Reagents Replenished
facilityNotes.content: Acids (Dilute HCl, H2SO4), bases (NaOH), litmus indicators, and optical glass prisms delivered. Class 10 practical sessions scheduled every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.

facilityNotes.title: SCERT AP Digital Curriculum Loaded on All 5 Panels
facilityNotes.content: All five 75-inch IFP touch panels have been upgraded with 2026-27 revised SCERT AP interactive textbooks, Byju's supplementary modules, and GeoGebra simulation packages. Teachers must lock panels after 4:30 PM.

facilityNotes.title: New Trigonometry & Geometrical 3D Manipulatives Available
facilityNotes.content: Clinometer angle finders and 3D surface area geometric solids are placed in Cabinet B. Students are encouraged to use them during remedial hours.

facilityNotes.title: We Love Reading Campaign Books Cataloged
facilityNotes.content: Added 120 new English illustrated storybooks and National Book Trust science biographies. Student barcode lending cards issued to Classes 6 through 9.

classroomActivities.title: Class 6 Physical Education: Agility Drills & Kho-Kho Practice
classroomActivities.description: Junior students learning zig-zag running, dodging, and team coordination techniques on the playground.

classroomActivities.title: Class 9 Chemistry: Acid-Base Neutralization Titration
classroomActivities.description: Hands-on experiment testing pH scale with blue/red litmus paper and phenolphthalein indicator. Every student documented observation notes.

classroomActivities.title: Class 10 Biology: 3D Animated Human Circulatory System
classroomActivities.description: Students explored double circulation and heart valve mechanics on the Interactive Flat Panel with live touchscreen rotation and student quiz participation.

classroomActivities.title: Class 8 Mathematics: Pythagoras Theorem Tile Verification
classroomActivities.description: Visualizing square areas constructed on hypotenuse and legs of right-angled triangles using colored geometric wooden tiles.

classroomActivities.title: Class 7 English: Guided Silent Reading & Vocabulary Journaling
classroomActivities.description: Weekly library period where students selected regional folklore tales in English, note down five new words, and drafted a 50-word synopsis.

activeCampaigns.title: Smart Classroom Digital Pedagogy Adoption

activeCampaigns.title: Swachh Andhra - SASA Green & Clean Campus Drive
